conversations.title: The cautious champion
conversations.hidden_setup: The ops champion wants a win, but a previous vendor lost IT's trust; only the right people can remove each blocker.

buyer.name: Mira
buyer.text: Every Friday four analysts copy order data between spreadsheets. I need the weekly report before lunch, but I am not buying another dashboard just because it says AI.

turns.seller_reply: Let us start with Friday's reporting process: how many staff-hours does it take, which inputs create rework, and who would approve a small trial if the result is measurable?

offer_policy.product: OpsPilot, an operations AI assistant for a fictional distributor

discovery.scope: Process mapping and a synthetic-data prototype; no production access.

pilot.scope: One workflow, up to 25 users, read-only Microsoft 365/SharePoint/CSV connectors.

rollout.scope: Production expansion after a completed pilot and accepted results.

offer_policy.rollout_gate: All pilot gates plus a completed pilot with accepted results.
offer_policy.contract_gate: Verbal assent can prepare an agreement; it never means a signed sale or permission to deploy.
offer_policy.approval_scope: Approvals are package-specific; a scope change requires new approvals.
